work.title: Production goobs security audit and regression-backed fixes
work.body: Operator requests deep production security audit throughout goobs-frontend. Requires Opus or Sonnet 5+ per team contract. Base ed9edccb1492b862363aa894aa6c57b4b6aaf5f6, v0.302.4, clean tree. Audit all source HTML/URL sinks, navigation/window.open, diagnostics/sensitive fields, browser storage/messaging, file import/export, dependency advisories, package/CI trust boundaries. Reproduce findings, fail-first unit/browser/Storybook regressions, fix whole classes at shared roots, selftested guards with scan denominators. Codex handles non-security React lifecycle/memoization/design consistency/tests. Coordinate package version and generated Storybook changes before integration. Bun/npm/git only, no PowerShell; never discard/reset/restore/revert/stash/clean/amend, never push. Operator publishes npm. Previous automatic source review inconclusive: remote workers used workspace mirrors lacking the goobs SHA. Read root CLAUDE, goobs rules, dev-loop, live memory. Return findings, audited denominator, red-to-green tests, remaining gaps, commits. Additional gates: typecheck, browser tests, build. lint:all is existing combined gate, not exhaustive security proof.

work.title: goobs 0.302.5: +64 KB-gz per route (eager sanitize-html + entities) - lazy-load the sanitizer, budget the delta
work.body:
MEASURED 2026-10-04 (bun cache 0.302.3 vs installed 0.302.5, gzip level 9): dist/goobs-frontend.es.js raw 1,332,207 -> 1,555,974 B (+223,767); gzip 255,167 -> 321,038 B (+65,871 B = +64.3 KB-gz). CSS unchanged. ThothOS ship:perf-budget (170 KB-gz first-load ceiling, operator decision 2026-08-27) was already RED on every dashboard route (166 routes, 146.8-685.6 KB-gz) before the pin; 0.302.5 adds up to +64 KB-gz to every route that loads goobs. Cause (0.302.4 ed9edccb): the editor sanitizer moved from regex to `sanitize-html` + `entities` as eager runtime deps, plus the severity control.

Brief (class-first, goobs-frontend repo, operator publishes): (1) measure which chunks grew (vite --sourcemap / rollup-plugin-visualizer or scripts/lint-bundle-budget.ts breakdown) and attribute the +64 KB-gz; (2) load the sanitizer lazily (dynamic import inside the rich-text/editor path only, keep the allowlist contract and the fail-first tests from 0.302.4); consider `entities` -> the platform `DOMParser`/textarea decode where it is only used for text output; (3) tighten lint:bundle-budget so a +10% gzip jump on the ES bundle is RED, not just the ~91% ceiling (T16: known debt is hard red); (4) bump the version, run the publish gate, operator publishes; ThothOS re-measures ship:perf-budget after the pin. Never de-advertise the editor sanitization (T11).

work.title: Independently-verify-ThothOS-companion-boundary-W-1850
Require justification for customer and staff ticket severity changes (OQ 2.216)
work.body:
Operator explicitly delegated goobs-frontend work to the existing Codex seat on 2026-10-03. Latest product ruling from ThothOS owner audit W-974 / OWNER_QUEUE 2.216: customers AND staff may set ticket severity, and BOTH must provide a justification when changing it, required in UI and enforced by ThothOS server. Other staff-only fields remain protected. Claude is only optional final UI; do not enlist existing Claude seats.

Implement the library half locally, coordinating the callback contract with codex:01a0ff85-b63c-71e3-ae26-3ecbf9494802 through announcements. That seat owns ThothOS server rules, consumer wiring, end-to-end acceptance and owner-queue edits; do not concurrently edit those files.

Verified current source:
- src/components/ProjectBoard/forms/ShowTask/inline.tsx:1304-1313: staff edit mode has a plain Severity dropdown; no reason field.
- Same file:262-340 and 1321-1329: CustomerSeverityUplift is customer-only, lists higher levels only, requires a trimmed reason, calls onRaiseSeverity({taskId,severityId,reason}).
- src/components/ProjectBoard/index.tsx:590-591 forwards callback only for customer variant.
- src/components/ProjectBoard/types/index.tsx:471 declares the customer raise-only callback.
- ThothOS customerTicketEditAuthority.ts currently enforces reason length20..2000 and raise-only; company.entity.ts applyStaffCompanyTaskUpdate currently changes severity without justification.

Acceptance: customer and staff can make allowed severity changes with a required trimmed justification, field errors stay visible, failed async saves keep draft/reason, successful changes clear it, unchanged severity does not demand a new reason, and unrelated staff-only controls stay unavailable to customers. Operator said both may SET severity; default interpretation includes raising/lowering with justification. Call out any ambiguity before retaining the old uplift-only UI. Agree one callback/payload spelling with parent; candidate payload remains {taskId,severityId,reason}. Avoid parallel one-off widgets or duplicate policy homes. Cover staff/customer, blank/whitespace, pending/error/success and unchanged-state behavior in the repo's current stories/browser tests and required checks.

Your PROGRESS.md says verified 0.302.4 audit release is awaiting commit; preserve that work. ThothOS currently pins0.302.3, so a local goobs source/build is not proof of consumer behavior. Report commit/version/export changes and consumer steps. Publishing remains the operator's step per your existing release instruction; no push/publish or shared :3009 restart requested.

Other pending goobs context (not a second unclaimed implementation mandate): ThothOS W-801 was reopened by verification 2026-10-03T04:17Z. Flip geometry works; SearchableSimple/History passed3/3, but MultiSelectChip option click failed3/3 because the popover disappeared during inventory document refresh. Source timing vs product state loss needs diagnosis before claiming fixed; parent retains current proof and can share it. The already verified W-929 permissions-matrix/F-CO-09 work should not be redone. OQ2.5's 170KB-gzip consumer first-load ceiling is an operator decision; do not raise it to absorb added eager payload.
